up: Find all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5725296. Return the molecule's ChEMBL ID and preferred name (pref_name). Use the docs table to find the document, then join to compound_records using doc_id, and then to molecule_dictionary using molregno. Ensure each molecule appears only once (distinct). Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725296';
